name: Infinite Scroll
description: Loads the next batch of content automatically when a sentinel scrolls into view via IntersectionObserver.
usage:
<InfiniteScroll
  hasMore={hasMore}
  loading={loading}
  onLoadMore={loadNextPage}
  endMessage="All caught up"
>
  <ReportRows rows={rows} />
</InfiniteScroll>

anatomy.description: The accumulated children rendered as a plain block.
The aria-hidden marker whose intersection with the viewport triggers onLoadMore.
A role="status" spinner while loading, replaced by the end message when hasMore is false.

dos: Set an endMessage so the end of the feed is explicit.
Gate requests with hasMore and loading to prevent duplicate fetches.
Offer another route to footer content, since infinite lists push it away.
donts: Don't use it when users need to reach a specific record; use Pagination.
Don't auto-load task lists the user must finish; continuous loading hides the finish line.
Don't rely on the sentinel without a fallback; unsupported environments show a Load more button.

examples.title: Sentinel loading
examples.description: Scrolling the list to the bottom triggers onLoadMore and appends the next batch, with a spinner while it loads.

examples.title: End of feed
examples.description: With hasMore={false} the sentinel disappears and an end message tells the reader there is nothing left.

guidance.useWhen: Feeds and long result lists where readers browse continuously, such as activity streams or search results.
guidance.avoidWhen: Data where users need to reach a specific record or the footer; use Pagination or a VirtualList instead.
guidance.behavior: Calls onLoadMore only while hasMore is true and loading is false; without IntersectionObserver it falls back to a manual Load more button.
guidance.responsive: Renders as a plain block around its children, so the content's own responsive layout is untouched.

notes: The default loader is a role="status" region, so screen readers hear that more content is loading.
Without IntersectionObserver support a real Load more button keeps the feature operable.
The sentinel itself is aria-hidden and adds nothing to the accessibility tree.

props.description: Message shown once there is nothing left to load.
props.name: endMessage

props.description: Whether more items can be loaded.
props.name: hasMore

props.description: Content shown while the next batch loads.
props.name: loader

props.description: Whether a batch is currently loading; suppresses further triggers.

props.description: Margin around the sentinel at which loading starts, e.g. `'200px'`.
